root_causes_and_v41_fixes.issue: HUD overlay stole Windows input focus and interrupted live game control
root_causes_and_v41_fixes.root_cause: Interactive HUD transition needed strict non-activating styles and immediate game focus restoration across collapse/expand/re-collapse states
root_causes_and_v41_fixes.fix_in_v41: Enforced WS_EX_NOACTIVATE | WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW | WS_EX_TOPMOST, WM_MOUSEACTIVATE -> MA_NOACTIVATE (3), ShowWindow(Handle, 4) SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE, and RestoreGameFocusIfRunning() in Launcher.cs and CrimsonTrainer.cs (verified by --self-test Gate 5)

root_causes_and_v41_fixes.issue: One-beat input/refresh lag during active HUD interaction
root_causes_and_v41_fixes.root_cause: Polling spawned external Python subprocesses instead of direct in-process binary/state reads
root_causes_and_v41_fixes.fix_in_v41: Removed subprocess spawns on hot refresh paths; verified zero python subprocess spawn and GetSaveFileSilverAmount < 250ms in Gate 5 plus 0 Apply-RealCheats processes under watcher daemon

root_causes_and_v41_fixes.issue: HUD layout legibility under compact overlay widths
root_causes_and_v41_fixes.fix_in_v41: Audited via --dump-ui achieving OVERLAP_COUNT=0 and unclipped preset badge layout

root_causes_and_v41_fixes.issue: Stale historical CSVs re-triggered RSI generations (Gen #137-#139)
root_causes_and_v41_fixes.root_cause: Missing monotonic file mtime watermark allowed Nov 7/8 CSV files to re-enter evolution cycles
root_causes_and_v41_fixes.fix_in_v41: Added monotonic watermark_mtime filter (1794636324.702) in RsiEngine.py analyze_unprocessed_sessions and locked recommended arm back to FSR67_QualityHigh
